title: Xi launches World AI Cooperation Organization at Shanghai WAIC
summary: In his first World AI Conference keynote, Xi Jinping announced a Shanghai-based World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, reportedly with 29 founding countries, and criticized US export curbs.
reason: New multilateral AI body led by China; adds coordination though as a rival bloc.

title: Tata Electronics sets mid-2028 target for India's first chip fab at Dholera
summary: Reports detailed the roughly Rs 91,000 crore Tata-PSMC fab for up to 50,000 wafer starts a month; IT Minister Vaishnaw said operations should start mid-2028.
reason: Adds to sovereign compute and chip supply outside the US/Taiwan; still years away.

title: China claims first commercial invasive brain-chip implant
summary: Chinese reports said a brain-computer interface implant had moved from trials to commercial use; details are limited and unverified.
reason: BCI commercialisation claim; unverified so T1, D.
